chapter: Working in New York and Europe
title: Alvin Queen in Switzerland
summary: He met Alvin Queen in the expatriate scene but never played with him.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I wonder if you ever played with Alvin Queen over there?

I remember, I think I met him and I know he was busy in that sort of expatriate world of I guess Switzerland. Maybe he was in Geneva, I forget for sure, or Lausanne. We met but I never played with him.
